title: PhysxPhysicsDistanceJointAPI
summary: Spring behaviour of a distance joint: enable flag, stiffness and damping of the spring that acts when the distance leaves [minDistance, maxDistance]. Read only on a PhysicsDistanceJoint prim; inert on every other joint type.
producer_scope: All three declared attributes are published at their resolved values (false, 0, 0 when unauthored). No rewrite.

columns.name: physxPhysicsDistanceJoint:springEnabled
columns.absent: Hard distance constraint; the spring stiffness and damping columns are then not applied (PhysxLimitAPI:distance stiffness/damping remain in effect).

verify.notes: Observable only when springEnabled is true in the same variant; the sample set authors both. With the spring disabled the getter returns PhysxLimitAPI:distance stiffness (0 without that API), which equals the absent value.

interactions.rule: Read only in the distance-joint branch of the parser, gated by usd-schemas CONTAINS PhysxPhysicsDistanceJointAPI. On any other joint type the columns are ignored.
The runtime first applies PhysxLimitAPI:distance stiffness/damping to the PxDistanceJoint, then overwrites both with the spring values when springEnabled is true.

findings.summary: The stage-wide presence flag for this API is computed by the walker but never consulted by the parser, which goes straight to the per-prim schema probe. Dead performance gate, no correctness effect.
